seo.title: Montessori Guide Certification — Online Diploma Courses
seo.description: Train as a Montessori Guide with our online Montessori diploma courses: internationally recognized certification, expert faculty, and a flexible pace.

schema.descripcion: Online diploma courses to train as a Montessori Guide, with faculty mentorship and internationally recognized certification.

hero.kicker: International certification • 100% online • At your own pace
hero.title: Diploma Courses: <linea>Montessori Guide</linea>
hero.p1: Programs designed to give you deep, practical knowledge of Montessori education and the Montessori method. Graduate as a Montessori Guide with an internationally recognized certificate.
hero.p2: We are the Asociación Montessori de México (Mexico's Montessori Association, founded in 1965), a Mexican institution with international reach: we train Montessori Guides online for students all over the world.

card.p1: By the time you complete your program, you will be ready to work as a Montessori Guide at any school in the world and make a real difference in your students' lives. Study from anywhere with our online platform.
card.acceso: Your access includes: <fuerte>Google Workspace</fuerte> (1 TB of Drive storage, an institutional email address, and Google services), plus study supported by <fuerte>Google AI</fuerte> (NotebookLM, Gemini).

contenido.titulo: Everything you need to become a Montessori Guide
contenido.descripcion: Each subject unfolds in blocks of about 9 sessions (one per week), with materials, activities, and guidance from your course instructor to answer questions and go deeper.

filosofia.descripcion: Discover the history and principles behind the Montessori method.

observacion.descripcion: Develop the ability to observe and understand the unique needs of each of your students.

neuroeducacion.descripcion: Discover how the human brain develops during the earliest stages of life.

psicologia.descripcion: Discover how students integrate their environment and how to ensure meaningful learning.

musicoterapia.descripcion: Learn about the importance of music in learning through the Montessori bells.

psicomotricidad.descripcion: Explore how movement is fundamental to development and learning.

inclusiva.descripcion: Learn how knowledge, the environment, and pedagogy are prepared for every kind of learner and every child's needs.

creativa.descripcion: Foster creativity and innovative thinking in all of your students.

practica.descripcion: You will learn Maria Montessori's scientific materials and how to present them at each stage of development.

modalidad.intro: Study at your own pace with new content every week and ongoing support:

publicacion.texto: A new class is published every Saturday at 8:00 a.m.

actividades.texto: Submit whenever you like while the subject is active (about two months per subject).

acceso.texto: Review your classes whenever and wherever you want.

guia.texto: Request a video call with your instructor whenever you need it.

profesores.titulo: Meet the people who will accompany you through your certification
profesores.intro: Throughout this diploma course you will be accompanied by people with experience, training, and a deep commitment to the Montessori philosophy. We want you to get to know the team that will walk alongside you through this journey.

parrafos: Roxana Muñoz Guevara holds a <fuerte>Licenciatura (Bachelor's degree) in Preschool Education</fuerte> from the Universidad Femenina de México, with further studies in Special Education, Applied Psychomotor Development, and Child Psychology, and trained as a <fuerte>Montessori Guide for Elementary I and II</fuerte> at the Centro de Desarrollo y Comunicación.

She also completed additional studies with <fuerte>Dr. Cato Hanrath</fuerte>, a student of Maria Montessori. Since <fuerte>1997 she has served as President of the Asociación Montessori de México A.C.</fuerte>, where she coordinates the Professional Montessori Guide Diploma Courses and teaches Philosophical Anthropology, Montessori Philosophy, and Montessori Materials.

She is currently <fuerte>General Director of the Elementary School and of the Centro Educativo Montessori Kalpilli</fuerte>, as well as a trainer of Montessori Guides in Mexico and abroad. Her mentorship within the diploma course brings academic depth, institutional experience, and a perspective deeply faithful to the Montessori philosophy.

Iván is part of the teaching team for this diploma course. He holds a <fuerte>Licenciatura in Educational Intervention</fuerte> with an inclusive-education focus from the Universidad Pedagógica Nacional, a <fuerte>Licenciatura in the Arts</fuerte> from IDMA, and a <fuerte>Master's degree in Educational Sciences</fuerte> from the Instituto de Estudios Universitarios.

He brings <fuerte>15 years of experience</fuerte> in education and a solid track record within the Montessori philosophy. He is certified as a <fuerte>Montessori Guide for Children's House, Elementary I and II, and Nido and Infant Community</fuerte> by the Asociación Montessori de México.

He is currently an <fuerte>in-person course instructor for the Asociación Montessori de México</fuerte> at the Acapulco campus, training Children's House and Elementary Guides. He also <fuerte>coordinates the Montessori department at ECNH</fuerte> and develops workshops for teachers in public and private schools.

Carlos is part of the team that supports the organization, follow-up, and development of the diploma courses. His relationship with Montessori is also lived experience: <fuerte>his entire education, starting in the Nido, was Montessori</fuerte>, so he knows the method firsthand.

He holds <fuerte>Licenciaturas in Economics and in Public Accounting</fuerte> and is also a programmer. This combination allows him to bring administration, analysis, technology, and academic organization to the service of Montessori training. He has also pursued <fuerte>Master's studies in Music</fuerte>, focusing on piano and composition.

Within the diploma course, he contributes <fuerte>structure, clarity, and practical solutions</fuerte> that strengthen the student experience, weaving together Montessori, academic management, analytical thinking, and technology with a genuine commitment to education.
